description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerGroup class within the Opencart admin module. It provides methods for managing customer group data, including listing, retrieving info, creating JSON files, and clearing generated files, specifically for administrative tasks related to customer groups.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Represents the admin controller for managing customer groups, including generating task lists, listing customer groups as JSON files, retrieving specific customer group info, and clearing generated files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes customer group task list by clearing old tasks and creating new ones.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file with the list of customer groups and logs related tasks.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates a JSON file containing detailed information about a specific customer group, identified by 'customer_group_id'.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing generated JSON customer group files.
